targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS sessions FROM mirage.sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts)
SELECT countIf(logged_in = 1) AS logged_in FROM mirage.sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts)
SELECT count() AS commands FROM mirage.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND class = 'process_activity' AND action = 'command' AND outcome != 'failure'
SELECT count() AS unknown FROM mirage.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND class = 'process_activity' AND action = 'command' AND outcome = 'failure'
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, class, count() AS events FROM mirage.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, class ORDER BY time

SELECT start_ts, session_id, src_ip, client_version, username, logged_in, failed_logins, commands, unknown_commands, round(duration_s, 1) AS duration_s, arrayStringConcat(command_list, ' ; ') AS commands_run FROM mirage.sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts) ORDER BY start_ts DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT JSONExtractString(payload, 'command') AS command, countIf(outcome != 'failure') AS n, countIf(outcome = 'failure') AS not_found FROM mirage.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND class = 'process_activity' AND action = 'command' GROUP BY command ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT JSONExtractString(payload, 'username') AS username, JSONExtractString(payload, 'password') AS password, outcome, count() AS n FROM mirage.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND class = 'authentication' AND action = 'login' GROUP BY username, password, outcome ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 50
